prompt: A right hand in a slim, close-fitting dark brown leather shooting glove, seen alone, first-person game viewmodel. The hand grips an invisible round shotgun grip about 4 cm thick: the middle, ring and little fingers wrap fully around it, the thumb wraps over the top, and the index finger is held straight forward along the side, off the trigger. Thin supple leather with fine seams and knuckle creases, a snug wrist strap. Above the glove an olive green hunting jacket sleeve, long, reaching to mid forearm, ending in a soft open cuff. Realistic proportions, an adult hand, not bulky, not a cartoon. One solid part. No gun, no object in the hand, no text or logo. Realistic materials, neutral even lighting, no background.
notes: WHY v2 (Director, 2026-10-01 night, Karen asleep; Meshy API budget 300 credits given by Karen ~23:20: 'with gloves ect you can use up to 300crediths'). Karen chose GLOVES over the target game's bare hands ('with gloves nicer', 2026-10-01 ~23:00). v1 (Karen's own Meshy run, 2026-09-27) read bulky in first person, and its short cuff showed its open end to the camera as a black disc in the break-open frame. v2: slim close-fitting leather, the same two grips as v1 (right: three fingers round the wrist, index straight along the side; left: palm up, cradling the forend), and a LONG olive sleeve to mid forearm so the cuff end sits off screen. sizeMetres: hand ~0.20 m plus ~0.25 m of sleeve; Meshy normalises scale anyway and the camera config is the dial.
